verdict.rationale: Goodwin's own venture capital page says a team of over 180 lawyers handles "early and growth stage venture deals" and represents over 1,200 emerging companies and 200 VC/PE firms. The Founders Workbench Capital Calculator models preferred-stock issuance under different financing terms, which implies priced-round work. However, client counts stand in for deal volume, and no specific transactions are cited, so only the stage-coverage half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: stated deal volume or representative priced-round transactions on the firm's pages, explicit seed-through-late-stage (Series A/B/C+) round coverage, and independent corroboration.
